canonical_statement: Provisional two-parameter form: on a nonempty complete metric space, a proper lower-semicontinuous function bounded below sends every epsilon-approximate minimizer u, for positive epsilon and lambda, to a point v no worse than u, at distance at most lambda from u, and strictly minimizing the epsilon/lambda metric perturbation against every distinct point.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: u : Type u with MetricSpace u and CompleteSpace u; f : u -> EReal (or a Real-valued bounded-below specialization); epsilon lambda : Real
ordered_binders: metric and completeness structures on X
hypotheses: u is an epsilon-approximate minimizer of f
conclusion: There exists v with f v <= f u, dist u v <= lambda, and for every w != v, f v < f w + (epsilon / lambda) * dist v w, subject to the final codomain/coercion convention.
degenerate_cases: epsilon = 0 and lambda = 0 are excluded by positivity
the empty space is excluded because the input point and witness must exist
an identically +infinity objective is excluded by properness
points where the extended-real objective is infinite require an explicit finiteness convention
